中文摘要

越来越多的国际/国家组织发布了鼻咽癌（NPC）临床实践指南，为临床医生在治疗方面做出循证决策提供了宝贵参考。然而，各种推荐意见存在显著差异，导致在选择最优策略时存在不确定性。作者系统检索了数据库和组织网站，查找2000年1月至2025年11月期间发布的NPC指南。所有识别出的指南均进行了质量评价；最终共纳入26部被评定为推荐使用的临床实践指南。对涵盖所有管理方面（诊断、分期、放疗、全身治疗、随访监测、生物标志物以及复发/转移性疾病的挽救治疗）的推荐意见进行了总结，并对其一致性和差异进行了比较分析。对于诊断检查、分期系统以及晚期疾病的诱导化疗联合同步放化疗存在强烈共识，而在放疗细节方面存在显著差异，尤其是靶区勾画、选择性照射范围和剂量规定。尽管不同分期组的全身治疗策略大多一致，但在替代方案和治疗细节方面存在显著差异。这是首个对国际NPC指南进行的全面系统综合，为临床医生了解所有推荐意见并根据当地资源和专业知识选择最优方案提供了实用参考，同时指出了当前需要未来研究以进一步标准化和协调统一的争议点。

英文摘要

Increasing numbers of clinical practice guidelines have been published by international/national groups for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), providing valuable references for clinicians in making evidence-based decisions on treatment. However, there are substantial discrepancies in various recommendations, leading to uncertainties in choosing the optimal strategies. The authors systematically searched databases and organizational websites for NPC guidelines published between January 2000 and November 2025. All identified guidelines underwent quality appraisal; in total, 26 clinical practice guidelines rated recommended for use were included. The recommendations covering all management aspects (diagnosis, staging, radiotherapy, systemic therapy, follow-up surveillance, biomarkers, and salvage of recurrent/metastatic diseases) were summarized and comparatively analyzed for consistency and disparities. Strong consensus exists for diagnostic workup, staging systems, and induction chemotherapy plus concurrent chemoradiotherapy for advanced disease, whereas marked disparities exist on radiotherapy details, particularly target volume delineation, elective coverage extent, and dose specifications. Although systemic therapy strategies for different stage groups were mostly consistent, substantial disparities exist in alternative options and treatment details. This first comprehensive systematic synthesis of international NPC guidelines provides a practical reference for clinicians to understand all recommendations and select optimal options based on local resources and expertise while identifying current controversies that demand future research for further standardization and harmonization.
